blocks.title: Dataq Compass — reference flow in production
blocks.note: The design principle here is simple: evidence is captured where the work happens, not reconstructed later across the enterprise, which keeps the blast radius of any change inside one lane.

blocks.x: Under the hood the pattern is a composition, not a monolith: 4 tower services, the Dataq Compass platform for rails, and your estate at core systems for truth. Every boundary is a contract; every contract has an SLO and an owner.

items: Diagnose (2-4 weeks)
The engineering bet is explicit: every state change is replayable from the signed baseline across the enterprise, and rollback is rehearsed before go-live rather than after the incident.
Prove (6-10 weeks)
The engineering bet is explicit: each stage owns its latency budget and its failure policy across the Industry Use Cases estate, so drift shows up as a ticket with an owner, not as a mystery.
Industrialize (1-3 quarters)
The engineering bet is explicit: models, agents and rules move through versioned, evaluated releases for the enterprise at scale, so the question of how we know gets a pointer, not a paragraph.
Compound (ongoing)

The build earns trust the same way every gate does: the decision path and the audit path share one timeline in Data, Analytics & Lakehouse delivery, which is what makes the reported delta defensible in audit.

blocks.x: Day to day, the operating team sees one control surface: health, throughput, cost and policy violations for the workloads Dataq Compass carries. Escalations arrive with the context attached — the runbook, the affected scope, the last passing evidence — instead of a raw alert and a hunch.

MLflow, evaluation frameworks, guardrail libraries, GRC integration — integrated through versioned contracts. Adapters to core systems (CRM, ERP, core banking, EHR, WMS/MES, SCADA) are maintained like products: schema changes are tested against consumer suites before release, and one contract update propagates to every human or agent consumer.
